name: C# (.NET 8) - Azure Functions + Durable (Codespaces-safe)
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; echo "node=$(node -v) npm=$(npm -v)"; if ! command -v func >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Installing Azure Functions Core Tools v4..."; for i in 1 2 3; do npm install -g azure-functions-core-tools@4 --unsafe-perm true && break || { echo "retry $i"; sleep 2; }; done; fi; echo "dotnet=$(dotnet --version)"; func --version; az version >/dev/null'
